entries.description:
StarfireTalent40 yd range
2.25 sec castRequires DruidCall down a burst of energy, causing (121.8% of Spell Power) Arcane damage to the target, and [(121.8% of Spell Power) * 70 / 100] Arcane damage to all other enemies within 10 yards. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

Generates (80 / Warrior of Elune: 104 / Wild Surges: 100 / Moon Guardian: 100 / 10) Astral Power.

InstantRequires DruidRequires Cat Form, Bear Form Balance, Guardian, Restoration

 Feral

Awards 1 combo point.

Moonkin FormTalentInstantRequires DruidShapeshift into [Glyph of Stars: Astral Form / Moonkin Form], increasing the damage of your spells by 10% and your armor by 125%, and granting protection from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

Balance
While in this form, single-target attacks against you have a 101% chance to make your next Starfire instant.

entries.name: Nurturing Instinct

SunfireTalent1.8% of base mana40 yd rangeInstantRequires Druid Feral, Guardian, Restoration

Generates 0 Astral Power.

entries.description:
Primal FuryRequires DruidWhile in Cat Form, when you critically strike with an attack that generates a combo point, you gain an additional combo point. Damage over time cannot trigger this effect.

Fly to a nearby ally's position.

Tiger DashTalentInstant45 sec cooldownRequires DruidRequires level 25
Shift into Cat Form and increase your movement speed by 200%, reducing gradually over 5 sec.

The first time an enemy attempts to leave the vortex, winds will pull that enemy back to its center. Usable in all shapeshift forms.

Bear Form: Versatility

Wrath and Starfire shift you into Moonkin Form, if known.

entries.description:

Perform a powerful off-role ability depending on your currently active shapeshift form.

 Balance, Feral

Non-shapeshifted:
Empowered Wild Growth that heals up to 5 injured allies within 30 yards of the target for [(305.9% of Spell Power) * 750 / 100] over 7 sec.

 Guardian
Perform a powerful off-role ability depending on your currently active shapeshift form.

Empowered Wild Growth that heals up to 5 injured allies within 30 yards of the target for [(305.9% of Spell Power) * 750 / 100] over 7 sec.

Cat Form:
Unleash an empowered Feral Frenzy, clawing your target 5 times for [5 * (16.3% of Attack Power) * 1000 / 100] Physical damage and an additional [5 * 1000 / 100 * (32.67% of Attack Power) * 6 / 2] Bleed damage over 6 sec. Awards 5 combo points.

Moonkin Form:
Call down waves of empowered falling stars upon enemies within 40 yds, dealing [54 * (27% of Spell Power)] Astral damage over 8 sec.

Nature spells deal 15% additional damage and Wrath damage is increased by 40%.

 Eclipse (Lunar)
Arcane spells deal 15% additional damage and Starfire damage is increased by 40%.

Gaining Astral Power with Starfire has a 30% chance to launch a Starsurge at a victim at 50% effectiveness.

 Guardian

 (100ms cooldown)

entries.name: Stellar Command
entries.description:
Stellar CommandTalentRequires Druid Balance
Increases the damage of Fury of Elune by 15% and the damage of Full Moon by 25%.

 Guardian
Increases the damage of Lunar Beam by 30% and Fury of Elune by 15%.

entries.name: Atmospheric Exposure
entries.description:
Atmospheric ExposureTalentRequires Druid Balance
Enemies damaged by Full Moon or Fury of Elune take 6% increased damage from you for 6 sec.

 Guardian
Enemies damaged by Lunar Beam or Fury of Elune take 6% increased damage from you for 6 sec.

entries.name: Moondust
entries.description: MoondustTalentRequires DruidEnemies affected by Moonfire are slowed by 20%.

entries.name: Elune's Grace
entries.description: Elune's GraceTalentRequires DruidUsing Wild Charge while in Bear Form or Moonkin Form incurs a 3 sec shorter cooldown.

Guardian
Lunar Beam increases Arcane damage you deal by 10% while it is active.

entries.name: Lunar Calling
entries.description:
Lunar CallingTalentRequires Druid Balance
Starfire deals 120% increased damage to its primary target.

Wrath no longer changes your Eclipse ability's mode to Solar Eclipse.

 Guardian
Thrash now deals Arcane damage and its damage is increased by 12%.

nodes.name: The Light of Elune / Astral Insight

entries.name: The Light of Elune
entries.description:
The Light of EluneTalentRequires DruidApproximately 1 procs per minute Balance
Moonfire damage has a chance to call down a Fury of Elune to follow your target for 3 sec.

 Fury of Elune
Calls down a beam of pure celestial energy, dealing [3000 / 1000 * 2 * (18.34% of Spell Power)] Astral damage over 3 sec within its area.

Generates 15 Astral Power over its duration.

 Guardian
Moonfire damage has a chance to call down a Fury of Elune to follow your target for 3 sec.

 Fury of Elune
Calls down a beam of pure celestial energy, dealing [3000 / 1000 * 2 * (18.34% of Spell Power)] Astral damage over 3 sec within its area.

Generates 18 Rage over its duration.

entries.name: Astral Insight
entries.description:
Astral InsightTalentRequires Druid Balance

Increases the duration and number of spells cast by Convoke the Spirits by 25%.

 Guardian

Increases the duration and number of spells cast by Convoke the Spirits by 25%.

Lunar Beam's cooldown is reduced by 20 sec.

 Balance
Your Arcane abilities reduce the cooldown of Fury of Elune by 1.5 sec and the cooldown of New Moon, Half Moon, and Full Moon by 1.0 sec.

 damage increased by 10%. Lunar Beam's damage dealt to its primary target increased by 30%.

 Balance
Starsurge damage increased by 5%. 
Starfall damage increased by 10%.

entries.name: The Eternal Moon
entries.description:
The Eternal MoonTalentRequires Druid Balance
Further increases the power of Boundless Moonlight.

 Fury of Elune
The flash of energy now generates 6 Astral Power and its damage is increased by 50%.

 Full Moon
New Moon and Half Moon now also call down 1 Minor Moon.

 Guardian
Further increases the power of Boundless Moonlight.

 Lunar Beam
Lunar Beam increases Mastery by an additional (15 * $mas)%, deals 30% increased damage, and lasts 3 sec longer.

 Fury of Elune
The flash of energy now generates 6 Rage and its damage is increased by 50%.

entries.name: Dream Surge
entries.description:
Dream SurgeTalentRequires Druid Balance
Force of Nature grants 3 charges of Dream Burst, causing your next Wrath or Starfire to explode on the target, dealing [(393% of Attack Power) * 1.06] Nature damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced above 5 targets.

 Restoration
When Grove Guardians are summoned, they grow Dream Petals on your target, healing up to 3 nearby allies for (146.4% of Spell Power).

entries.name: Treants of the Moon
entries.description:
Treants of the MoonTalentRequires Druid Balance
Your Force of Nature treants cast Moonfire on nearby targets about once every 6 sec.

 Restoration
Your Grove Guardians cast Moonfire on nearby targets about once every 6 sec.

entries.name: Expansiveness

Your maximum mana is increased by 5% and your maximum Astral Power is increased by 20.

 Restoration
Your maximum mana is increased by 5%.

entries.name: Sylvan Beckoning
entries.description:
Sylvan BeckoningTalentRequires DruidApproximately 1 procs per minute Balance
Entering an Eclipse summons a Dryad to assist you for 8 sec, casting Starsurge dealing (150% of Spell Power) Astral damage and Starfall at 250% effectiveness.

 Restoration
Your periodic heals have a chance to empower your next Swiftmend to summon a Dryad to assist you, casting Tranquility at 10% effectiveness and Regrowth to heal (658.507% of Spell Power) damage onto your lowest health ally.

Every 5 Starsurges you cast makes your next Regrowth or Entangling roots instant.
